uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1746-3899-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Accomplished Automaton.
When Accomplished Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Accomplished Automaton enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1170-2099-5131-7052--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2099-5131-7052--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Savvy Trader.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

1429-4981-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5256-5542-6145.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6145.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Passageway Seer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Passageway Seer enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Passageway Seer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Passageway Seer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Passageway Seer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Passageway Seer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6145.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1563-7686-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1563-7686-7730.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1563-7686-7730.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

3532-5078-6289-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-6289-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

660-978-6972.description:
Activate Treva's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Treva's Attendant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Repeat.

2092-3944-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Blood Pet from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3175-5256-7424.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

943-4235-6745.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five artifacts. Uthros has twelve or more charge counters on it
943-4235-6745.description:
Activate Uthros, Titanic Godcore by paying {U} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Uthros, Titanic Godcore.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Deserted Temple.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping Deserted Temple and Uthros, Titanic Godcore
Repeat
943-4235-6745.notes: With excess mana, you can instead untap another land instead of Uthros, Titanic Godcore.

2034-2048-4215.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken green creature.
2034-2048-4215.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a nontoken green creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the green creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1753-2539-3094-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
1753-2539-3094-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3996-4050-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {2}{W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Spirits, adding {2}{W}.
When the Spirits die, Twilight Drover triggers three times, putting three +1/+1 counters on itself.
Repeat from step 2.

1315-2366-4875-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1315-2366-4875-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1308-5448-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1308-5448-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Druid Class
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

2604-3532-3761-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2604-3532-3761-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

1978-3007-4851.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1978-3007-4851.description:
Animate Timeless Lotus using Toymaker.
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

5641-5789-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5641-5789-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

338-4631-4929.description:
Activate Essence Depleter by paying {1}{C}, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Cryptic Trilobite triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-392-1858-2056-6791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-392-1858-2056-6791.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

224-907-6628.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping PuPu UFO.
Repeat.

3484-3487-5870-6188-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out that is a 5/5 artifact creature with haste.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, its first ability, Aetherstorm Roc, Decoction Module and Guide of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out trigger, causing you to rummage.
Resolve the remaining triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker. The token triggers, causing you to untap a creature you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2423-2440-3263-4183.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
2423-2440-3263-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Bounding Krasis with haste.
When the token Bounding Krasis enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Bounding Krasis trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Bounding Krasis.
Repeat.

225-1170-3389-5921-5954.notablePrerequisites:
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-3389-5921-5954.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2523-5256-5559.description:
Cast Nazgûl by paying {2}{B}.
Nazgûl enters, triggering its first activated ability, causing the Ring to tempt you; choose Nazgûl as your Ring-bearer, making it legendary.
Nazgûl's second activated ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Wraith you control.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Nazgûl.
Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Nazgûl that's a 2/2 Zombie.
Resolve the ability from step 4, milling target player equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat from step 2.

575-2034-4489.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using {C}{C}{G}.
575-2034-4489.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate the creature by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the creature face-up, allowing you to play the creature from exile this turn.
Cast the creature from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the creature can be cast using two or less mana, this combo nets infinite mana.

1020-1822-2866-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken artifact with mana value one or less that can be cast using only colorless mana.
1020-1822-2866-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the nontoken artifact with mana value one or less and Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, its ability triggers twice, returning Scrap Trawler and the nontoken artifact with mana one or less to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Scrap Trawler and the nontoken artifact by paying at most {4}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the nontoken artifact and Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Scrap Trawler triggers twice for itself dying, and twice for the nontoken artifact.
Resolve the Scrap Trawler triggers for the nontoken artifact, returning any applicable artifact to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the remaining Scrap Trawler triggers, returning the nontoken artifact and Myr Retriever to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast the nontoken artifact and Myr Retriever by paying at most {3}.
Repeat.

3903-5151.description:
Whenever a player casts a noncreature spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Deafening Silence prevents players from casting more than one noncreature spell each turn, players cannot cast a noncreature spell permitted by Knowledge Pool, or any other noncreature spell that turn.

774-3756-4826.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Izzet Boilerworks onto the battlefield.
Izzet Boilerworks triggers, targeting itself.
With the trigger on the stack, tap Izzet Boilerworks for {U}{R}.
Allow the trigger to resolve, returning Izzet Boilerworks to your hand.
Repeat.
